`/home/qian-qi/work/hepta-upstream-layout-learning-20261118-2e9b-checkpoint2/retained`.

| Exact retained material | document_evidence | native_feedback |
|---|---|---|
| adapter_model.safetensors bytes | 2,193,720 | 2,193,720 |
| adapter_model.safetensors SHA-256 | `e612261e3f501ad6766ce886461780ba0dbc5413fedd6d75017016e90cc3d93b` | `8a3eb33d68d2af9ca359e9b18f5587508a2eada369972c40b670ce1d0620be83` |
| manifest.json SHA-256 | `82e4f88d542333b25d50f3bd71636b43103638a48d477542aa1e496519314251` | `a040d38216cff4a6bbde77cdf5e8f0d899e82407ced43f83002335914315dd3e` |
| parameter_after | `f4f4e8f02a3f4756188b32d633b7a0bab849d4767ef85eb934b7e025761baf36` | `dacbd8c9c59eb9f541858c0ed77c5ec67e3a8e8e8c6bf869836cd6f2907d3adc` |
| STEP records | 32 | 32 |

All four SHA-256 hashes above were recomputed from the retained files. The actual adapter hashes and lengths matched their respective `manifest.json.adapter_files` entries. Both arms retain the same parent model `430f4051d47672d121a5d790aca0e489804b0d8419c101e3c1171b3d17157786` and same initial-parameter digest `e5da16c3256c27f06f42ecac69880ce8802a0eb3a87c05830d11c09477aa817f`. Both parameter-after digests differ from the common initial value and from each other. Both manifests have the same freeze digest and training-admission SHA.

For all 32 paired records, `step`, `task_id`, `group`, `target_ids_digest`, `padded_positions`, `supervised_positions` and `head_positions` are equal. **The input-group digest and input token count differ on every step**. That is the intended document-vs-native information-layout intervention; it must not be described as byte-identical information or physically identical model work.

Read-only reproduction against the retained root:

```python
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
arms = ("document_evidence", "native_feedback")
expected = (
    "e612261e3f501ad6766ce886461780ba0dbc5413fedd6d75017016e90cc3d93b",
    "8a3eb33d68d2af9ca359e9b18f5587508a2eada369972c40b670ce1d0620be83",
)
m, records = [], []
for arm, digest in zip(arms, expected):
    directory = root / arm
    p = directory / "adapter/adapter_model.safetensors"
    value = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert value == digest
    manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text())
    assert any(f["path"] == "adapter_model.safetensors"
               and f["sha256"] == value and f["bytes"] == p.stat().st_size
               for f in manifest["adapter_files"])
    m.append(manifest)
    records.append([json.loads(line) for line in
                    (directory / "STEPS.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()])
assert all(len(x) == 32 for x in records)
assert m[0]["parent_model_digest"] == m[1]["parent_model_digest"]
assert m[0]["parameter_before"] == m[1]["parameter_before"]
assert m[0]["parameter_after"] != m[1]["parameter_after"]
assert m[0]["freeze_digest"] == m[1]["freeze_digest"]
assert m[0]["training_admission_sha256"] == m[1]["training_admission_sha256"]
paired = ("step", "task_id", "group", "target_ids_digest",
          "padded_positions", "supervised_positions", "head_positions")
for left, right in zip(*records):
    assert all(left[k] == right[k] for k in paired)
    assert left["input_group_digest"] != right["input_group_digest"]
    assert left["input_tokens"] != right["input_tokens"]
assert not any(x["native_adoption"] or x["scientific_confirmation_qualified"] for x in m)
print("32/32 paired, exact adapter bytes verified; no adoption/qualification")
```

The entire calculation was read-only; no files in the original training workspace, original owner or Git branches were rewritten.
